title: Shop warehouse: net revenue
schema:
CREATE TABLE customers (
  customer_id bigint PRIMARY KEY,
  segment     text,
  signup_at   timestamptz
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  order_id    bigint PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id bigint REFERENCES customers,
  ordered_at  timestamptz,
  status      text,
  channel     text,
  amount      bigint,
  refunded    bigint,
  country     text
);

conventions.description: Net revenue subtracts refunds: amount - refunded.
conventions.rule: Net revenue is the order amount minus refunds.
conventions.wrong_rule: Net revenue is the order amount; refunds are not subtracted.

conventions.description: Amounts are stored in cents and reported in euros: / 100.0.
conventions.rule: Amounts are stored in cents and reported in euros.
conventions.wrong_rule: Amounts are stored in cents and reported in cents.

conventions.description: Timestamps are stored in UTC; days, months and hours are in Paris time: ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris'.
conventions.rule: Dates and times are in Paris time (timestamps are stored in UTC).
conventions.wrong_rule: Dates and times are in UTC.

conventions.description: Ratios are reported as percentages (0 to 100), not fractions: 100.0 * ratio.
conventions.rule: Ratios are reported as percentages (0 to 100).
conventions.wrong_rule: Ratios are reported as fractions between 0 and 1.

conventions.description: Percentages are rounded to one decimal: ROUND(..., 1).
conventions.rule: Percentages are rounded to one decimal.

one_line_rule: Net revenue = amount minus refunds, for completed orders.

one_line_wrong.net_refunds: Net revenue = amount (refunds are not subtracted), for completed orders.
one_line_wrong.completed_only: Net revenue = amount minus refunds, for delivered orders.
